{

    "check": "vp check",

    "lint": "vp lint src runtime-tests build perf-measures benchmarks adapters",

    "format": "vp fmt --check \"src/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"runtime-tests/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"build/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"perf-measures/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"benchmarks/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"adapters/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\"",
    "format:fix": "vp fmt \"src/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"runtime-tests/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"build/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"perf-measures/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"benchmarks/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\" \"adapters/**/*.{js,ts,tsx}\"",

    "copy:package.cjs.json": "cp ./package.cjs.json ./dist/cjs/package.json && cp ./package.cjs.json ./dist/types/package.json",
    "build": "pnpm run remove-dist && vp pack && pnpm run copy:package.cjs.json && publint",
    "watch": "pnpm run remove-dist && vp pack --watch && pnpm run copy:package.cjs.json",
    "coverage": "vp test --run --coverage",

    },

part.text: I have the full picture. The bug: `redirect()` only calls `encodeURI` when the string contains multibyte chars; an all-ASCII Location with raw CR/LF is set verbatim, enabling header injection. I'll percent-encode raw CR/LF in both branches (percent-encoded input like `%0A` is untouched), then add regression tests.

files.patch:
Index: src/context.ts
===================================================================
--- src/context.ts
+++ src/context.ts
@@ -773,9 +773,13 @@
     this.header(
       'Location',
       // Multibytes should be encoded
       // eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex
-      !/[^\x00-\xFF]/.test(locationString) ? locationString : encodeURI(locationString)
+      !/[^\x00-\xFF]/.test(locationString)
+        ? // Raw CR and LF in a header value enable header injection. Percent-encode them
+          // while leaving already percent-encoded sequences (e.g. `%0D%0A`) untouched.
+          locationString.replace(/[\r\n]/g, (char) => (char === '\r' ? '%0D' : '%0A'))
+        : encodeURI(locationString)
     )
     return this.newResponse(null, status ?? 302) as any
   }

Done.

## What was wrong

`Context.redirect()` (`src/context.ts:768`) only ran `encodeURI()` when the Location string contained multibyte characters. For an all-ASCII Location containing raw CR/LF, the value was passed verbatim to `this.header('Location', ...)`, allowing response-header injection (or a runtime `TypeError`), e.g. `c.redirect('/x\r\nSet-Cookie: evil')`.

## Fix (`src/context.ts`)

- In the all-ASCII branch, raw `\r` → `%0D` and `\n` → `%0A` before setting `Location`.
- The multibyte branch continues to use `encodeURI()`, which already percent-encodes CR/LF.
- Already-percent-encoded input (`%0D`, `%0A`, `%20`, URLs with `://`, etc.) is untouched, so valid redirects and existing behavior are preserved.

## Regression tests (`src/context.test.ts`)

- Raw CR, raw LF, and CRLF injection attempts → Location is percent-encoded, status stays 302, and no injected header exists.
- Multibyte + CRLF → both multibyte encoding and CR/LF encoding happen.
- Percent-encoded CR/LF inputs (`%0D%0A`, `%0A%0D`) remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

## Verification

`pnpm exec vp test --run src/context.test.ts` → **Test Files 1 passed, Tests 68 passed (68)**. Changes are left unstaged for your review; nothing was committed.
